_comment: DATA-ONLY WATCHLIST (added 2026-09-13). Fetched every night by the same fetch.py in the same eodhd pod — BEFORE the main pass (src/bootstrap.sh) — into data/watchlist/, a subtree nothing downstream reads: build_m1 and validate glob data/ohlcv/*.json non-recursively, stage2 sentiment reads data/news/, load_spy reads data/market/. 2026-09-16: the 11 equities this list was created for (AAL, AAOI, ARM, ASML, ASTS, BE, MSTR, RKLB, SNOW, SOFI, TSM) were PROMOTED into the model universe and their files moved from data/watchlist/ into the main trees, so what remains here is BRK-B plus the two ETFs. BRK-B is in the main S&P lists too (the models read that 2000+ copy); this copy adds its history from the 1996-05 listing and is the reason the subtree still exists. To promote a name, move it into the `stocks` list of tickers.json, sharadar.json and tiingo.json, give it a from_overrides entry there if it has history older than their from=2000 (those datasets refetch in full and would otherwise truncate it), and move its existing files across — a symbol with no file is full-fetched, but only back to the config window. Windows start 1990 so each name's whole listed history lands (SPY 1993, BRK-B 1996); eod/dividends/splits re-pull the full window nightly at 1 credit each regardless of length.
_market_comment: ETFs ride the market slots, not `stocks`: a fund has no Earnings::Trend, so `estimates` would append empty snapshots forever. SPY.US duplicates tickers.json's data/market/SPY.US.json on purpose (2 credits a night) so this tree is self-contained and reaches 1993 rather than 2000.
